# Original Terminal41 directory-index evidence (April 2020)

These four files are unmodified original screenshots preserved in the publicly archived [Playdead Unofficial Discord ARG-solving export](https://github.com/gamesbyian/playdead-unofficial-exports) at upstream source snapshot `5e5897e2ce70dad5a2bd85e459770637cb36610f`. They are **historical witnesses, not project-produced reproductions**.

| Screenshot | Original Git blob SHA-1 | Original size | Direct evidence |
|---|---|---:|---|
| `sys-index.png` | `48cdd698a5d9303609cd2659d020a0c31a52cffc` | 119,780 | `/sys/all_sys_hibernate/` and backup printer-status filenames |
| `terminate-terminal-index.png` | `e3d7287527a5482cb58a41837873f396e0c79ee7` | 40,251 | terminal `11/`, `23/`, `41/`, `42/`, `99/` |
| `dat-index.png` | `a56809a9856020489a87ff38d114ae4a67d83964` | 70,405 | `saf_dat_col_BACKUP.html` and `breachlog_BACKUP.html`; some names truncated |
| `breach-backup-contrast.png` | `95bb5aaec9a9f2da0966744fbc80b67f7f358c99` | 393,082 | nonidentical current/backup contributor-registry page states |

Source-specific findings, dates, exact-route versus inferred-name distinctions and original speaker chronology are in [CL09 research](../../../docs/conjecture-lab/2026-10-08-terminal41-unarchived-route-recovery.md) and [11-entry gap census](../../../data/terminal41-screenshot-index-gaps-2026-10-08.json).

Warning: Apache “Last modified” timestamps are *server-reported*, not independently proved creation times; no screenshot proves the missing files still exist publicly or that their contents can accept CE foreground symbols. Some backup filenames are visibly truncated in listings and completed using original first-person messages. Original images and attribution are from their authors and are copied for scholarly source preservation; this repository does not claim those rights.
